parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the results to return. Default value: **1**, which indicates that results start from page 1.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The timestamp of the task end time to query, in milliseconds.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of tasks per page in a paged query. Default value: **20**, which indicates that each page contains 20 tasks.

parameters.name: RootTask
parameters.description: Specifies whether the task is the root task of the virus scan.

parameters.name: RootTaskId
parameters.description:
The root task ID.
> Call [GetVirusScanLatestTaskStatistic](~~GetVirusScanLatestTaskStatistic~~) to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: ScanType
parameters.description:
The scan type of the virus scan task to query. Valid values:

- **system**: automatic system scan
- **user**: custom user scan.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The timestamp of the task start time to query, in milliseconds.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The execution status of the virus scan task. Valid values:
- **1**: Scanning.
- **2**: Completed.
- **3**: Failed.
- **4**: Timed out.

parameters.name: StatusList
parameters.description: The list of statuses used to filter tasks by multiple statuses.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description:
The ID of the virus scan task to query.
> Call [ListVirusScanTask](~~ListVirusScanTask~~) to obtain this parameter.
